label.explanation: notifications was restored from a snapshot but its id AUTO_INCREMENT was left behind the restored rows (line 168). New inserts are handed ids that already exist and violate the primary key (lines 180, 195, 205, 211). notification-svc's create failures (lines 186, 217, 233, 279) and api-gateway errors (lines 189, 199, 222, 234, 250, 260, 280) follow. Reset the sequence past max(id). Red herrings: line 66 (a one-off slow reporting query on audit_log, not on the failing request path).
